# SEO-179: Connect each page node to the site node and its primary entity

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

The page-level node references the site-level node through isPartOf and names the thing the page is principally about through mainEntity or mainEntityOfPage.

## Rationale

Without those references the page node is an isolated description that says the page exists but not what it belongs to or what it covers, which is the part a consumer assembling a picture of the site needs.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_structured_data"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Emit both nodes in one graph per page and link them by identifier rather than by nesting a second copy of the site node inside the page node. Name the primary entity only where the page has one clear subject.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Resolve the isPartOf and mainEntity references in the parsed graph and confirm each points at a node that the same graph or a declared identifier defines.
- Evidence: `JSON_LD`, `ROUTE`, `VALIDATOR_OUTPUT`
- Automated check: none.
